direct.question: Does a finished admitted start satisfy N1 and violate N3?
direct.weighting: One count per seeded design. Each block of 24 draws crosses four pair-coholding probabilities with six counts of group cells. Cell pairs are chosen independently at the selected probability. Draw one to three chain bases uniformly, assigning each to a cell uniformly with replacement and giving each base its own private live knot.
direct.method: Check every set of bases outside chained twins on the same core. Realize a survivor by replacing every disabled offshoot with a pair at a fresh live knot, then recheck. Compute cores from the designed groups, realizing a start only on a separating design.
